integrity: The proof and executable finite checks are bundled; independent scientific validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Binary input and least-significant-digit-first complete DFAOs on every finite word; exact finite formula for all nonnegative shifts and moduli at least two. title: Exact minimal automata for shifted binary digit sums modulo \(m\)
